summary: Eldorado NF tree-platform lookout (1911 or circa 1913); cabin burned 1937, removed 1974, tree lost in 2014-15 wildfire; 2009 photo shows the foundation.

facts.design: Platform built into a tree about 60 feet up; BC-201 cabin and garage added in 1934
facts.status_note: Cabin and garage sold and removed in 1974; the lookout tree was lost in a wildfire in 2014-15 per the register
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Eldorado National Forest

events.note: Tree platform. Register photo caption says Constructed 1911; the Built field says circa 1913; a 1961 account also gives 1911
Forest ranger living at the lookout with his wife and a young child (1935 newspaper item)
House and an adjoining building destroyed by fire in July 1937
Cabin and garage sold and removed
Lookout tree lost to wildfire; register dates it 2014-15

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's Built field says circa 1913, but the same page's photo caption says Constructed 1911 and its description says as early as 1911. The 1961 account also gives 1911. The story uses 1911 for the tree platform and reports the Built field.
The register and the 1961 account give about 60 feet. A 1914 item gives 75 feet for the ranger's lookout. The story gives both.

The register says the cabin and garage built in 1934 burned in July 1937 and were rebuilt. The 1974 article dates the house and garage slated for removal to 1934 and does not mention a rebuild. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Two sources, both with history text. Built-date conflict (1911 vs circa 1913) and the 1934/1937 rebuild question are in resolved_conflicts. A WebSearch snippet links the 2014 King Fire to the Eldorado NF, but no source ties it to this lookout, so it is not used. No source found on current condition or access; check Eldorado NF before publishing a 'today' line. Photo captions only (1911 Mark Swift Collection; 2009 Ron Kemnow foundation; 1974 buildings story), no image URLs, so no photos entries. Brief events match the sources except the 1913 built date, which the story treats as one of two conflicting dates.
